column1: # Settings changes since a release, each with how existing users keep what they had.
# Scripts/check-settings-compat.sh compares this commit with the last release (the vX.Y tag) and
# fails on any new key, removed key, changed default or removed stored value not listed here.
# Columns, tab-separated: release compared against, kind (new, removed, default, value), key, migration.
# Lines for older releases no longer match anything and can be deleted after shipping.

column4: Internal one-time flag for the Wisp withdrawal; never a user choice.

Wisp leaves the starting dock: only new installs and an explicit Reset use it, since every existing install has dockApps stored (written on first launch). A dock that 3.31-3.34 gave Wisp on its own loses it once (dock.wispPageWithdrawn), unless wisp.enabled was stored true.
Restores the pre-3.30 behaviour (the bubble only while an agent needs you) for anyone who never set it; a stored value is kept.
Custom's new style picker; unset means Solid, which is how 3.34's Custom drew, so a saved Custom opens unchanged (check-appearance).
Second colour for the new Two-tone style; read only when style is Two-tone, which no existing user has.
Glass style setting for the new Custom Glass; Tinted Glass keeps its own keys, so nobody's glass changes.

The new Custom Picture's copied image; unset until someone picks a picture.
The chosen Ghostty theme; unset unless someone picks one, so every saved theme opens as before.

Two-tone's new default pairing (7A3558). Only people who never used Custom see the new per-style default.

Two-tone's colours kept while another style shows; written by the migration for anyone using Two-tone or with a second colour stored.
Glass's colours kept while another style shows; written by the migration for anyone using Glass or with a strength or blur stored.
Picture's colours kept while another style shows; written by the migration for anyone using Picture or with a picture stored.
Show covers and lyrics from your local music files; unset reads as off, so local Spotify songs keep the placeholder and no music folder is opened until someone turns it on.
Per-song lyric timing nudges set from the Music page lyric menu; unset means no nudge, so every song keeps the timing it had until someone moves it.
Per-song lyric timing nudges; empty unless someone nudges a song, so every song plays as before.

The music folder chosen for Show covers and lyrics from your local music files; unset (every existing install) keeps reading the folders Spotify names for anyone who already has the switch on, exactly as before. Only turning the switch on afresh asks for a folder, and cancelling leaves it off.
The dock's Answer out loud button is gone and Wisp always answers out loud when spoken to; per the owner, saved choices are not kept.

Keep Awake beside the closed notch. Written once on launch: on for a new install (no dockApps stored yet), like a running timer; off for every existing install (dockApps is written on first launch), so nothing new appears beside their notch until someone turns it on.
Wisp is held out of the product: its page is no longer offered and a saved dock drops it, at the owner's request.
What answers Wisp; defaults to Apple Intelligence, which is what answered before, so nothing changes until someone picks Claude, OpenAI or another service.

Which Music view is shown (Playing, Stats or Backups); starts on Playing, the player everyone had.
Stats shows songs or artists; starts on songs. Only read once Spotify is connected.
Weekly Spotify backups; on by default, but nothing runs until someone connects their own Spotify app.
The Client ID of the Spotify developer app someone connects; empty until they paste one.

ASCII art scene; vinyl by default, only read once ASCII is on.
ASCII art detail; medium by default, only read once ASCII is on.
ASCII art colours; theme by default, as before.
The Music page tinted by the cover; on by default, as before.
The Music page's look; standard by default, as before.
The White, Red and Amber ASCII inks (3.60 only) are themes instead; a saved one reads as Theme.

Lyrics follow the look at the owner's request: Standard shows Poster, Terminal its own line; the saved choice is no longer read.
The last of the dead setting: since 3.42 nothing reads it and Wisp always answers out loud when spoken to, so a stored value changes nothing.

The Clock has drawn only Regular since 3.15; the World Clock migration no longer writes dot and a stored dot or map no longer widens the tile.
Swiping sideways on the closed notch changes songs; off by default, so existing installs behave as before.
What each timer does when done (also timer2.whenDone, timer3.whenDone); unset reads as Nothing, as before.
The desktop's number and name beside the closed notch after a Space change; registered off, so existing installs behave as before.
What the Spaces widget's user named each desktop, by Space uuid; unset reads as no names, and nothing is added to a saved Home.
Each pop-out's shape in the clear look; unset reads as its default (the song a squircle, the rest circles), as before.
Whether the Music Player settings card is open; only how the card shows, no setting changes.
Whether the Pop-outs settings card is open; only how the card shows, no setting changes.
The Weather page's chosen place; unset reads as automatic, as before.
Each timer's colour (also timer2…timer8); unset reads as the slot's own, so the first three look as they did.
Whether a running timer shows beside the notch (also timer2…timer8); unset reads as yes, as before.
Do Not Disturb while this timer runs (also timer2…timer8); unset reads as no, as before.
The Timers page's Focus chip, for the next timer; unset reads as off.
The Timers page's Notch chip, for the next timer; unset shows it, as before.

The Timers page no longer has a Focus tab.

Colours changed on a Terminal theme, by theme; unset means themes keep their own colours, as before.
Terminal themes' shared see-through, blur, fade and picture; unset reads as solid with none, as before.
Custom's look; unset reads from its saved style, so a saved Custom looks as it did.
The Vinyl look's parts linked to other theme colours; unset means every part keeps the colour it had.
A timer's Theme, Clear, theme colour or chosen colour; unset keeps the colour it had (timer.tint).
Everything beside the closed notch takes the theme's colour; unset means each keeps its own colour, as before.
On for new installs only: written once when no dock is stored yet, so an existing install keeps what it has; an explicit Reset uses it.

The bubbles following the theme; unset or empty means each keeps its own colour, as before.

Whether the Music Player card was open. It now has its own page and is always open; a stored value is simply no longer read.

Unset is off: a cloud model learns nothing of your calendar, as before, until Share when you're free is turned on under Settings, Tsukumo, Gateway.

glass (3.95's glass KemoSabe) becomes "kemosabe" with kemosabe.look "glass": the same picture (WispCharacter.migrateGlass).
Set at first launch for any copy that has run before (it already has settings), so only a new install opens the walkthrough by itself.
Unset is Automatic, the best installed voice for your language, which is what replies used before; only choosing a voice under Settings, Tsukumo, Voice sets it.
Whether the Tape Keyboard settings card is open; only how the card shows, no setting changes.
Whether the Tape Managed Apps settings card is open; only how the card shows, no setting changes.
Whether the Nook Keyboard settings card is open; only how the card shows, no setting changes.

Unset reads kemosabe.shareFreeTimes: on is When you're free, off is Nothing, exactly what was shared before; only the Gateway card's Calendar menu sets it.
Unset is Nothing, so nothing new is shared until chosen in the Gateway card.
Unset is off, so other questions get no answer, as before.
Unset is no rules, so answers go exactly as the levels allow, as before; only typing rules in the Gateway card sets it.

Unset is Automatic: Wisp in black or white as before, and KemoSabe in its saved kemosabe.look (unset Apricot, "glass" Pearl at full glass), exactly what each showed; only picking a colour under Settings, Tsukumo, Agent sets it.
Unset is the saved kemosabe.look's glass: 1 for "glass", otherwise 0 (solid felt), as before; only the Glass slider sets it, or picking a palette while kemosabe.look is "glass", which writes 1 first.
Unset is Apricot's body; read only while Custom is picked, which no existing user has.
Unset is Apricot's face; read only while Custom is picked, which no existing user has.

No longer has an @AppStorage default; unset still means Apricot (AgentColours.ownKemoSabe), and a saved id or "glass" shows the same colours under Automatic until a palette is picked, which removes it.

Unset is the best voice model downloaded for this Mac, and nothing is downloaded until Download is pressed under Settings, Tsukumo, Voice; only Use there sets it. wisp.voice keeps every saved value; recorded:<id> is a new value only tagging a voice sets.
Whether the Agent card's colour cards are open; only how the card shows, no setting changes.
Whether the Voice card's Voices from recordings section is open; only how the card shows, no setting changes.
Only whether the Themes card was open; the Appearance page is now just the theme list, always shown, so a stored value is simply no longer read.
Unset is off, so answers go as soon as the levels and rules allow, as before; only the Gateway card's Ask me before sharing sets it.
Folio's watched folders; unset is none, so nothing is watched and no Watched place shows until someone presses Add Folder under Settings, Folio, Watched folders and picks a folder.
The Folio page's view; unset is Rows, the only view before, so the page opens as it did until someone picks Columns, List, Infinity or Board from its header or with Command-2 to Command-5.

Unset unless a theme other than the agent's own palettes is picked in the Agent card's theme list, which saves its colours here with its list id in agent.palette; every palette id saved before (automatic, custom, apricot and the rest) still resolves to exactly its colours, now also the theme of the same name.

Unset keeps what everyone had: KemoSabe at agent.glass (0.5 and up, the only value the switch wrote being 1, is full glass) or its saved look's glass, and Wisp solid; only the Agent card's Glass slider sets it. Full glass now draws the felt art frosted in the same pose instead of the separate glass picture, by the owner's request.
The voice Studio reads scripts with; unset is Automatic, the best Mac voice for the language. Studio is new, so nothing read before; only its voice menu sets it.
The pace of Studio's new takes; unset is 1, the voice's own pace; only Studio's pace slider sets it.
The style Studio asks of the Expressive engine (CosyVoice 3); unset is none, so it reads as the clip does; only Studio's style chips and field set it.
Studio's delivery for voices from recordings that have one; unset is Natural, the voice's own clip, as every voice read before deliveries existed; only Studio's delivery rows set it.

The Music page Shelf's All source is gone. The source was never stored (each launch opened on All, the default), so nothing saved changes; anyone on All now gets the default source, Liked Songs, one source at a time, and when it has no songs the first playlist that has some, as the menu lists them. The menu no longer offers All.

The Agent card list's Standard row is gone (it was never stored as a row: picking it saved agent.palette "automatic"). "automatic" and unset still resolve to AgentPalette.automatic, Wisp black or white and KemoSabe in its saved kemosabe.look (unset Apricot), exactly as before, just with no row picked; the card's header names it Original.

New installs only: AgentColours.startNewInstall saves Noir (own.macspaces with its colours in agent.themeColours) at first launch, only while welcome.seen is unset (WelcomeWindow.noteInstall sets it first for any copy that has run before) and no palette is stored. Every existing install keeps its stored palette, or unset Automatic, exactly as before.
Written with agent.palette by AgentColours.startNewInstall on a new install only (Noir's colours); existing installs never get it written on their own.
Unchanged: unset is already Noir (macspaces), so a new install's Nook starts on Noir and every stored theme opens as itself.

Dictation is now part of Studio. A saved dock with "dictation" and/or "prompter" gets Studio ("prompter") once, at the first of their positions, the rest in its order; a dock with neither is untouched. The raw value still decodes, and Open Dictation, Control-Option-D and the App Intent open Studio on Dictate (StudioModel.openDictation).

A new install gets the same pages as before in the Talk group's order, Studio then Meetings at the end, where it got Meetings then Dictation appended by dock.communicationPagesAdded; Reset, which left those two out, now includes them. Clipboard is no longer a page: its history is Folio's Clipboard place, collected for a new install and after Reset as before (folio.clipboardHistory). Saved docks are untouched (only the Dictation merge applies), and a page added later goes beside its group.

The Clipboard page is now Folio's Clipboard place. A saved dock with "clipboard" gets Folio ("tray") in its place, opening on Clipboard (folio.opensOnClipboard), unless Folio was already in the dock, which then keeps its place and opens on All Items as before; a dock without it is untouched. The raw value still decodes, and the Clipboard App Intent and the Home Clipboard widget's expand button open Folio on Clipboard. Home keeps its Clipboard widget.

Written once at launch: true when the saved dock had the Clipboard page (whose history it kept collecting) or for a new install (whose starting dock had it), false otherwise, so history is collected exactly when it was; only the Clipboard card's Keep history for Folio's Clipboard switch changes it.

Unset is off, so Folio opens on All Items as before; set once for a dock whose Clipboard page became Folio, so that button still opens the history; only the Clipboard card's Open Folio on Clipboard switch changes it.

The same key as before, now read by the Clipboard card's folded Ignore section instead of the Ignore drawer card; unset is closed as before and a saved open or closed is kept. Only how the card shows, no setting changes.

Set once at launch when the Gateway's old menus become rules (GatewayShare.migrateMenus). An existing install (dockApps stored) gets the plain rules that share exactly what its menus did, ahead of its own rules: Calendar Nothing (or unset with kemosabe.shareFreeTimes off) is "Never share anything from my calendar.", When you're free is "From my calendar, share only when I'm free or busy.", Reminders Nothing is "Never share my reminders.", and Answer other questions off is "Answer only questions about when I'm free, my events or what's due."; code decides these exactly as the menus did, before anything is read and with no model, so nothing loosens on any Mac. A new install starts with no rules and shares by judgement (a changed default for new installs only).

No longer shown or written; read once by GatewayShare.migrateMenus (unset still follows kemosabe.shareFreeTimes, nothing still means Nothing) and turned into the same plain rules. Left in place so an older MacSpaces still reads it.
No longer shown or written; read once by GatewayShare.migrateMenus (unset is still Nothing) and turned into "Never share my reminders." unless it was What's due. Left in place for an older MacSpaces.

No longer shown or written; read once by GatewayShare.migrateMenus (unset is still off) and turned into "Answer only questions about when I'm free, my events or what's due." unless it was on. Left in place for an older MacSpaces.
No longer written; read once by GatewayShare.migrateMenus while gateway.calendar is unset, exactly as before (on is When you're free, off or unset is Nothing). Left in place for an older MacSpaces.

The Gateway's Reminders menu is gone with its enum; the stored strings (nothing, due) are read as plain strings by GatewayShare.migrateMenus and become the same rule, so every saved value keeps its meaning.

How Claude is reached: cli (the signed-in Claude Code) or key (the API key). Unset is key when an Anthropic key is saved, which is what answered before, else cli; only Settings' Connect with menu writes it.

How Codex (the OpenAI provider, renamed) is reached: cli (the signed-in Codex) or key. Unset is key when an OpenAI key is saved, which is what answered before, else cli; only Settings' Connect with menu writes it.
Claude Code's model in the chat; unset is Claude Code's own default. Only the model menus write it.
Codex's model in the chat; unset is Codex's own default. Only the model menus write it.
Studio's Best Quality for voices from recordings; unset is Fast, one take per reading exactly as every take was made before; only the Quality rows in Studio's read options set it.
Whether Tape's Managed Windows card, now a drawer, is open; unset is closed. Only how the card shows, no setting changes.

A voice's clip is now picked Siren's way (one clip: surely them, passing the sample checks, cleanest) instead of joining its included Natural clips up to 20 s. A quality behaviour, not a setting: included and left-out clips stay as they were, and a Use First made before (the first clip is Natural and came from a later recording than another Natural clip, VoiceSamples.inferredPin) becomes a pin, so that clip keeps reading. Voices saved before 4.02 have one clip per delivery and read as before.
New fields in voice.json clips; nil for existing clips until the voice first reads (measured once then), and pinned only from Use First or the inferred pin above.

Anonymous install count (a random ID and the version to macspaces.dev, at most daily). Unset is off, so existing installs send nothing until turned on; new installs get it on (UpdateService.startNewInstall, only while WelcomeWindow marks the copy new).
The random install ID, made on the first count; internal, no setting changes.
When the last count was sent; internal, no setting changes.
The version the last count was sent for, so an update counts at once; internal, no setting changes.

Owner's decision, the one exception to the rule: unset now reads as on (registered default in UpdateService), so installs from before 4.08 that never touched the switch are counted. A saved choice is kept: anyone who turned it off stays off. UpdateService.startNewInstall is gone (the default covers new installs).
The Shelf's chosen source (Liked Songs or a playlist), saved when one is picked from its menu so a relaunch opens on it. Unset is Liked Songs, as before; cleared at sign-out.
The chosen source's name, saved with spotify.shelfChoiceID for the pill until the playlists are read; no setting changes.
The Meetings page's chosen app (zoom, meetSafari, meetChrome), saved when picked. Unset is Zoom, as before.
Keep Awake's chosen length for the next switch-on (0 is no limit), shared by the System card and the Home widget. Unset is 60, as before.
Whether Keep Awake's next switch-on keeps the display on too. Unset is off, as before.
Music Stats' chosen range (short_term, medium_term, long_term). Unset is 4 weeks, as before.
Appearance's Shuffle button: on takes another theme from the filtered list each time the Nook closes. Unset is off, so no one's theme changes until they turn it on.
The Dark or Light filter Shuffle draws from (all, dark, light), saved while Shuffle is on; no setting changes.
The pack Shuffle draws from (all, editorial, classics, ghostty, base16, gogh), saved while Shuffle is on; no setting changes.
